app.info.description: Read the Android wrapper version, build environment, and enabled native capabilities.

notifications.status.description: Read the current Android notification permission state without prompting the user.

device.identity.description: Read this installation's opaque device id so the server can register or check revocation.

notifications.register.description: Request Android notification permission if needed, configure notification channels, and return the push registration token and channel status.

biometric.status.description: Check Android BiometricPrompt and Credential Manager availability on this device.

biometric.authenticate.description: Prompt the user with Android BiometricPrompt or device credential for session unlock or re-authentication.

scanner.scan.description: Scan a barcode, QR code, or document using the Android camera scanner.

media.pick.description: Capture a photo/document with the camera or pick files from the Android document picker.

share.open.description: Open the native Android share sheet for text, URLs, or exported documents/PDFs.

printer.discover.description: List available Android print framework, network TCP/IP, and paired Bluetooth thermal printers.

printer.print.description: Print a receipt, label, kitchen ticket, or document via Android Print Framework, TCP/IP ESC/POS, or Bluetooth thermal printer.

crm.callerId.status.description: Read Android CallScreeningService role status and cached caller lookup state for the active tenant.

crm.callerId.sync.description: Sync tenant-scoped normalized customer caller ID entries or request the Android call screening role.

sync.status.description: Read Android WorkManager background sync status, network state, and tenant cache isolation state.

sync.trigger.description: Schedule or run an immediate tenant-scoped background sync or clear tenant native cache on sign-out/switch.

sync.acknowledge.description: Acknowledge the actual outcome of flushing the web IndexedDB offline mutation queue for a pending native sync request.

bridge.ready.description: Emitted once when the native port is bound to the active web frame.

navigation.deepLink.description: Emitted when an Android App Link or push notification deep link targets an in-app route.

crm.callEnded.description: Emitted when an incoming or outgoing business call completes so the user can log a CRM post-call activity.

sync.reconcileRequested.description: Emitted when Android WorkManager verifies origin reachability and requests the web runtime to flush and acknowledge its IndexedDB mutation queue.

sync.completed.description: Emitted only after the web sync pipeline acknowledges completed writes or when device revocation aborts sync.

media.capture.webFallback: HTML file input with camera capture
